headline: US jury convicts Huawei

sources.note: Official Eastern District of New York verdict release.

sources.name: Associated Press
sources.note: Independent wire report on the verdict.

verification_note: A federal jury found Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts, including trade-secret conspiracy and Iran sanctions violations.

sources.name: Associated Press
sources.note: Separate closing figures for major US indexes.

sources.note: Independent wire report of 23 injured.

headline: Brazil ends envoy’s posting

sources.name: Folha de S.Paulo
sources.note: 16:31 Brasília; confirmed independently by a Brazilian foreign ministry official, who said the decision had yet to be formally communicated.

verification_note: Brazil decided Ambassador Julio Bitelli would leave his post permanently as its diplomatic dispute with Argentina deepened.
